title: New zoning for Smith’s Ballpark redevelopment OK’d after height change
summary: It's been over two years since the Smith's Ballpark was last home to the Salt Lake Bees, but the site is now another step closer to being the next home for residents and businesses.

title: Motorcyclist killed after hitting a deer on SR-13
summary: A motorcyclist died Thursday morning after hitting a deer on state Route 13 in Box Elder County, according to the Utah Highway Patrol.

title: City council approves zoning changes for Provo Towne Centre redevelopment
